name: known correctness defect or runtime failure
definition: Comment asserts existing or generated code yields wrong results, mishandles inputs, loses data, breaks an invariant, or throws an exception, and the author treats the behavior as defective.
inclusion_criteria: Declarative bug/broken; wrong labels; shadowed logic; empty documents; off-by-one; pasted traceback; confirmed behavior norm not met.
exclusion_criteria: Style/refactor admissions; missing features; performance wishes; unverified suspicions; open questions; tests absent.
boundary_examples: Contrast with unverified behavior: symptom or concrete wrongness is asserted.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0030-aaedcebdc", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "[todo]: this is a bug; predict_proba should not change", "interpretation": "The author explicitly asserts a bug: predict_proba is changing when it should not. This is a declarative correctness defect with a named symptom (output mutation), not an unverified suspicion."}]

name: unverified behavior, comprehension, or suspected defect
definition: Author lacks confirmation about runtime behavior, input acceptance, concurrency, semantics, why code exists, or suspects a specific structural, shape, traversal, numerical, or theoretical problem without asserting a failure symptom; verification or investigation is deferred.
inclusion_criteria: 'check/verify' untested behavior; 'haven't checked'; 'might not work'; 'what does this do?'; suspected stride/alignment or shape mismatch.
exclusion_criteria: Known defects with symptoms; open design questions; performance benchmarks; committed deletions.
boundary_examples: Named mechanism but no confirmed wrong output; includes comprehension gaps.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0066-aahhdbjej", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "find out why prefix neg_ is needed", "interpretation": "The author states they need to 'find out why' the neg_ prefix is needed, which is a comprehension gap about why existing code exists, with investigation deferred and no defect asserted."}]

name: open design, organizational, or speculative proposal
definition: Author poses an unresolved design, API, placement, suitability, or feature-adoption question, possibly with a provisional answer or hedge, and does not commit to implementation; alternatives remain pending.
inclusion_criteria: 'where should this hook be called?'; 'dataframe pass needed?'; 'more flexible signature?'; 'maybe a DefaultEnvironment?'; 'Is that ok?'; modal hedges.
exclusion_criteria: Empirical checks; concrete missing computations; committed refinements; version-gated removal.
boundary_examples: Question with no committed remedy; committed refactors sans query go to structural codes.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0011-aageijaai", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# TODO: do we want gains/biases to be trainable?", "interpretation": "The author poses an unresolved design question about whether gains/biases should be trainable, without committing to an implementation or claiming a defect. The decision remains open and is phrased as an open question."}]

name: unimplemented named capability or api-parity gap
definition: A specific named function, input mode, operator, command, module feature, domain class, distribution step, placeholder, or public symbol is absent or partly implemented, including API-parity gaps; work is additive functionality.
inclusion_criteria: Missing optimizer/loader/attack/metric; missing 1D or matrix input; NumPy/scipy parity symbols; NOT IMPLEMENTED; 'write resolve method'; ignored weight; empty stub.
exclusion_criteria: Existing component merely inactive; config exposure; integration plumbing; structural refactor; scope limits not intended to extend.
boundary_examples: New capability named; contrast activation of existing capability.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0008-aagcbjjcd", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# TODO : load landmarks in validation and test set also.", "interpretation": "The TODO names a specific missing input mode: landmarks are loaded for the training set but not currently loaded for the validation and test sets, an additive capability gap."}]

name: deferred feature activation or restoration
definition: An existing capability is present but switched off in an entry point/configuration, or was dropped during migration and should be enabled, restored, or ported back.
inclusion_criteria: 'turn on' mode/flag; built component not switched on; migration tag with reintroduce/port for named capability.
exclusion_criteria: New capabilities never present; config externalization; input validation; dead-code relocation.
boundary_examples: Capability exists; only gate or restoration missing.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0159-aajbiahbe", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "self._audio = audio.AudioComponent(self) # TODO turn on", "interpretation": "The TODO sits on an already-constructed audio component and simply says to turn it on, meaning an existing capability is present but gated off in the code path."}]

name: component integration or workflow wiring gap
definition: Named existing components are not wired into the workflow, pipeline, or architecture; pending work is composition or plumbing, not a new algorithm.
inclusion_criteria: Integrate frontend and model into workflow; call remote model where component exists.
exclusion_criteria: Adding absent algorithms; structural refactors; documentation.
boundary_examples: Distinct from missing capability: parts exist, just not connected.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0009-aagdfgjig", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# TODO Change to call remote model", "interpretation": "The TODO states that the existing code should be changed to call a remote model, indicating that a named existing component (remote model) is not wired into the current workflow. The pending work is integration or plumbing rather than creating a new algorithm."}]

name: configuration externalization, parameterization, or argument propagation
definition: A hard-coded, fixed, computed-in-module, workspace-specific, or magic value/path/param/dtype/threshold should be exposed as configuration, derived, or passed to all sibling calls; includes unresolved configurability gaps.
inclusion_criteria: Make thresholds/seeds/process counts configurable; move to config; path portability; pass dictionary to all calls; 'hard coded for now'; 'make dtype configurable'.
exclusion_criteria: Adding wholly new capability; inert parameters; input validation; arbitrary logic relocation; simple naming.
boundary_examples: Value is fixed or propagation incomplete; not behavior change.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0046-aafchcgjg", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "\"confidence\": 1  # todo discussion confidence from GNormPlus is not provided so just putting in here 1", "interpretation": "A confidence value is hard-coded to a magic constant 1 directly in the writer rather than derived or configurable, reflecting an unresolved fixed-parameter gap."}]

name: redundant or inert parameter or api surface debt
definition: Overlapping configuration knobs should be consolidated/removed, or a named option/parameter has no effect on behavior and silently misleads; API-surface redundancy or unwired config.
inclusion_criteria: 'alpha_mean and density overlap - remove one'; explicit 'X is not used' for named option without warning/error.
exclusion_criteria: Simple renames; adding new parameters; hardcoded constants needing externalization; feature activation.
boundary_examples: Parameter exists but redundant or ineffective.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0246-aafehehgb", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "TODO alpha_mean and density overlap - remove one of them", "interpretation": "Two configuration knobs, alpha_mean and density, are stated to overlap, and the proposed remedy is to remove one. This is API-surface redundancy in named parameters, not a missing feature or behavior change."}]

name: validation, guard, contract, or diagnostic feedback gap
definition: Required guards, type/default checks, shape compatibility, invalid layer combinations, argument contracts, or runtime preconditions are absent, undefined, unsafe, or undiagnosed; includes unresolved isinstance-vs-duck-typing validation debates.
inclusion_criteria: Validate/normalize/set defaults; shape match; warn/error for Reshape; disable X without Y; duplicate check; exclusive open.
exclusion_criteria: Wrong results already produced; inert parameters; documentation; unimplemented code.
boundary_examples: Enforcement or diagnostic is missing; no wrong output asserted.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0004-aaejjacgf", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "!TODO: In some cases; US is not enough to hold the complete number", "interpretation": "The note flags that a US value may in some cases be insufficient to hold the complete number, pointing to a missing guard or capacity precondition rather than an asserted wrong output."}]

name: test coverage, compatibility, or tooling infrastructure debt
definition: Tests are missing, disabled, stubbed, weakly asserting, or failing due to CI/platform/encoding/dependency environment; admitted gap is verification or tooling, not production logic.
inclusion_criteria: Add tests; skipped tests; compatibility TODO in tests; placeholder assertions; broken check; GPU mocking; CI/encoding failures.
exclusion_criteria: Production defects; stale docs; test-message wording; verification of named invariant in production.
boundary_examples: Concern confined to test code/harness/tooling.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0019-aaigjhibg", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "((); 0); # TODO(sonots): Fix compatibility", "interpretation": "The TODO sits in a chainerx unit test file and says 'Fix compatibility', indicating a test-harness/platform compatibility gap rather than production logic. The concern is confined to test code."}]

name: documentation, observability, or reporting gap
definition: Deferred work is to write docs/docstrings/README/tutorials, explain an opaque parameter, clarify test messages, or add logging, timing, warnings, or reporting output; behavior is not claimed wrong.
inclusion_criteria: Update docs; create docstring; 'figure out what size does'; better test message; charts/summary/json output; add warning/logging.
exclusion_criteria: Runtime error behavior changes; missing tests; inert parameters; core logic defects.
boundary_examples: Communicative or observation output, not control flow.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0018-aajcabgbe", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "#TODO: this can become a nice tutorial for generating phantoms", "interpretation": "The TODO proposes turning the phantom-generation code into a tutorial, which is documentation/educational output rather than a code-behavior change. It defers writing instructional material."}]

name: self-labeled hack, shared-state, or coupling smell
definition: Author labels code a hack/kludge/for-now or mutable shared/global state that should be local, or code that exists solely to satisfy another module's method/flag, admitting hidden coupling.
inclusion_criteria: Hack/kludge labels; avoid module-level global; make attribute not part of self; block exists for another file's method.
exclusion_criteria: Known defects; micro-optimizations; missing state propagation; dead-code relocation.
boundary_examples: Author flags the smell; no concrete defect claimed.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0005-aaebbecaa", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# Hack to center SVG as justify-content is broken:", "interpretation": "The author self-labels the SVG-centering approach as a 'Hack', explicitly acknowledging a kludge used to work around broken justify-content behavior."}]

name: test-only scaffolding in production code
definition: A parameter, constant, or branch exists only to satisfy tests but lives in shipped application code; test concern mixed into production.
inclusion_criteria: 'for testing only!' on production GUI/config parameter; test-convenience hardcode.
exclusion_criteria: Test-file compatibility workarounds; feature flags unrelated to tests.
boundary_examples: Scaffolding shipped in app code, not test files.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0022-aahdfibcf", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "@todo nrows is for testing only!", "interpretation": "The comment explicitly labels 'nrows' as existing 'for testing only!' inside a production GUI module (interactive_summary.py). This is test-convenience scaffolding shipped in application code."}]

name: deferred structural refactor, representation, or interface redesign
definition: Deferred change to data representation, object model, local code shape, public signature/input contract, or abstraction level (dict to tuple, split functions, separate data from metadata, narrow over-general implementation, lighter identifier).
inclusion_criteria: Return dict to list/tuple; named tuple/enum; split block; separate metadata from data; parameterize class attributes; pass id instead of object.
exclusion_criteria: Pure identifier renames; performance substitutes; adding missing features; class/file relocation.
boundary_examples: Reshapes data contract or local code structure, no movement.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0003-aaejjbhji", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "!TODO: An empty dictionary would actually also do here ... despite the fact that", "interpretation": "The note suggests an empty dictionary would suffice instead of the current structure, which is a deferred change to the local data representation chosen in the code."}]

name: structural relocation, extraction, duplication, coupling, or canonical migration
definition: Existing code is misplaced, wrongly partitioned, duplicated, entangled across layers, or bespoke where a library abstraction exists; remedy is move, extract into class/file, consolidate, delete, decouple, or propagate canonical change.
inclusion_criteria: Separate class/file; move to backend; merge duplicate scripts; use standard library; 'add to other loaders too'; decouple DDP from SLURM; unify data resources.
exclusion_criteria: Local representation choices; performance-only work; API-breaking input redesign; pure renames; dead-code deletion without relocation.
boundary_examples: Code or resource moves/merges/deduplicates; target named.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0001-aahiieiig", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "Functions used by more than one algorithm || TODO refactor properly later", "interpretation": "The comment states the functions are shared by multiple algorithms and should be refactored properly, indicating existing code is entangled and the remedy is reorganization/consolidation rather than a new capability or fix."}]

name: naming or api-cleanup debt
definition: Proposed rename of an identifier, parameter, field, or option for consistency, spelling, or convention alignment; primarily nomenclature and public-surface tidiness.
inclusion_criteria: 'change normalizazion_database to normalise'; 'random_state to rng'; 'sizes to size?'; standardizing '_offset' vs 'offset'.
exclusion_criteria: Conceptual/representation refactors; adding new parameters; removing inert parameters.
boundary_examples: Pure name change, no contract shape change; signature narrowing goes elsewhere.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0076-aajfajibh", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "FIXME homogeneize the meaning of margin parameter", "interpretation": "The FIXME asks to homogenize the meaning of the `margin` parameter, which is parameter/API-surface consistency cleanup. It names no wrong behavior or missing capability; the debt is semantic naming/API tidiness around a public parameter."}]

name: performance, idiom, or redundant recomputation debt
definition: Working code is inefficient in time/memory or non-idiomatic, performs redundant recomputation or initialization, or artifact names a faster/cheaper primitive, vectorization, in-place rewrite, lazy loading, or complexity concern.
inclusion_criteria: np.partition; work inplace; broadcast; O(N); avoid CSR; memory notes; save grids once; config loaded once.
exclusion_criteria: Structural refactors for style; adding GPU support as capability; correctness verification; algorithmic redesign beyond spot optimization.
boundary_examples: Cost or repeated work named; behavior unchanged.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0017-aaffedgad", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "#TODO: improve the copying of parameters", "interpretation": "The TODO asks to 'improve the copying of parameters', naming a copying operation that is presumably inefficient or awkward; the target is a cheaper/cleaner copy mechanism, with no correctness fault claimed. This is performance/idiom debt about redundant or costly copying."}]

name: external-dependency workaround or cross-file or external-source debt
definition: Local code compensates for a named third-party/upstream/rendering/library/version constraint or lags external API drift; or debt originates in another file, external repo, or informal source.
inclusion_criteria: Library issue IDs; ONNX-conditioned change; svhn val-set workaround; 'TODO for replacer.py'; backward-compat shims for CPython/pandas bug.
exclusion_criteria: Self-labeled hacks without external cause; test-environment adaptations; local correctness defects.
boundary_examples: Cause external; local fix is stopgap.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0005-aaebbecaa", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# Hack to center SVG as justify-content is broken:", "interpretation": "The workaround exists because a named external rendering feature (justify-content) is broken, so the local code compensates for an upstream constraint."}]

name: methodological or domain-assumption concern
definition: Current statistical/algorithmic approach or WIP feature rests on a strong dataset-wide or domain assumption that may not generalize; documented inline without concrete fix.
inclusion_criteria: 'We are conditioning on...'; questionable reward assumptions; WIP 'assumes all sequences...'; restrictive preconditions.
exclusion_criteria: Concrete failing input combinations; known defects; performance; missing features.
boundary_examples: Concern is assumption validity, not implementation bug.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0045-aajdcegja", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "All diff tools here currently assumes the notebooks have already been", "interpretation": "The docstring documents a dataset/module-wide assumption: all diff tools assume notebooks are already converted to the same format version (v4). This is a strong precondition that may not generalize and is noted inline without a concrete fix."}]

name: alternative algorithm, model, or heuristic quality debt
definition: Artifact names a specific alternative mathematical formulation/algorithmic option, says a core algorithm or heuristic should be improved, or proposes changing a named model capacity/hyperparameter from a hunch; no failing input recorded.
inclusion_criteria: 'Dehaze with 1/t'; improve pruner/scheduler; 'double num_filters'; 'better job guessing defaults'; 'improve number parsing'.
exclusion_criteria: Spot performance vectorization; correctness fixes; adding missing input-shape support; scalar config externalization.
boundary_examples: Approach or default quality is target, not a fixed constant.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0006-aaahbghib", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# hackier; fixme to use regex or something", "interpretation": "The comment proposes using a regex 'or something' as an alternative approach to the current ad-hoc parsing, naming a better formulation/method for the logic."}]

name: device, memory, aliasing, or state-serialization debt
definition: Code makes a suboptimal hardware/device decision, has aliasing/copy-semantics uncertainty, unresolved reference-count ownership, import-cycle blocker, or fails to pass values/checkpoints across process boundaries.
inclusion_criteria: use is_cuda for GPU; 'is incref required?'; __deepcopy__; 'copy ?'; import issue; 'pass best score'; incomplete checkpoint state.
exclusion_criteria: Generic performance copy-removal; confirmed leak; packaging metadata; general cross-process logging.
boundary_examples: State movement across hardware, memory, or process.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0176-aadhfdfce", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "this is needed to update loss history", "interpretation": "The concern is passing/updating loss history state, i.e., state propagation across the run rather than a pure algorithm. The note addresses maintaining state consistency for loss history."}]

name: packaging, manual-setup, or asset-bundling gap
definition: A packaging manifest lacks required declarations, a setup/provisioning step is delegated to the user, or generated output depends on external assets/CDNs that should be bundled so output is self-contained.
inclusion_criteria: setup.py install_requires TODOs; incomplete pip installs; 'please download the dataset from'; include mpld3 JS libs; CDN references.
exclusion_criteria: Runtime capability gaps; documentation gaps; external library limitation.
boundary_examples: Distribution or self-containment concern.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0052-aaahbjdic", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "apparently package_deps are broken in 3.4", "interpretation": "The comment concerns package_deps in setup.py - packaging manifest declarations - so the issue sits in distribution/packaging setup."}]

name: behavioral override or normative policy reversal
definition: Current behavior is too aggressive, strict, or a configuration choice may be wrong; gating/relaxing is proposed, or a normative rule current code should adopt is asserted with relatively strong commitment.
inclusion_criteria: 'do not replace unless explicitly noticed'; 'don't make these a constant initializer'; 'dummy_na=False is what you want'; 'should not log nested parameters'.
exclusion_criteria: Missing capability; validation-only asks; correctness defect with concrete symptom; hedged suggestions.
boundary_examples: Policy change committed or strongly asserted.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0074-aajfadgji", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "FIXME don't l2_normalize for any metric", "interpretation": "The FIXME proposes changing the current normalization policy by not applying L2 normalization for every metric. It is a relatively strong normative rule about desired behavior, with no concrete failing input or wrong output asserted."}]

name: version- or status-gated removal
definition: Removal or substitution of code is tied to a release version, API experimental status, or deprecation state; debt is time-bounded or status-bounded with no re-enablement.
inclusion_criteria: 'in 1.1'; 'Remove in 0.26'; 'v1.3.0'; 'remove once estimator is no longer experimental'.
exclusion_criteria: Unscheduled cleanup; re-enablement or restoration of working capability; external library upgrade alone.
boundary_examples: Trigger is version/status; contrast activation code for re-enablement.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0061-aagfgggge", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "(TODO: coming in next release)", "interpretation": "The pending work is explicitly tied to a release status ('coming in next release'), which is a status-gated deferral of the addition."}]

name: cleanup, dead-code removal, or unscheduled deletion
definition: Working code should be deleted, de-duplicated locally, renamed locally, or tidied without claiming behavioral fault; removal or cleanup has no version, status, or named replacement trigger.
inclusion_criteria: 'clean up these initialization'; 'get rid of' code; 'remove timestamp_series_type'; vague 'deal with better'.
exclusion_criteria: Coupling or relocation with a named target; version/status-gated removal; magic constants needing derivation; structural consolidation.
boundary_examples: Deletion with no fault or relocation target.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0058-aaahbfbhe", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "DEPRICATE? I don't think this is needed anymore", "interpretation": "The author questions whether the code is still needed and floats deprecation, which is an unscheduled cleanup/deletion of possibly working code with no behavioral fault named and no version or status trigger."}]

name: personal-state or hand-off deferral
definition: TODO postpones work by citing author's momentary personal state (sleepiness, lack of time), waiting on a stated precondition, or delegating to another collaborator, without claiming a defect.
inclusion_criteria: 'too sleepy'; 'no time today'; 'can you?'; 'I can't manage'; waits on base distributions; 'set check_hash to True on final model'.
exclusion_criteria: Version-gated removal; open design choices; generic deferral without handoff or precondition.
boundary_examples: Deferral rationale is logistical or delegated.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0008-aagcbjjcd", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# TODO : load landmarks in validation and test set also. I'm too sleepy to do it today -_- zzz... zzz...", "interpretation": "The TODO postpones the work by citing the author's momentary personal state ('too sleepy to do it today'), a logistical deferral rather than a claimed defect."}]

name: deferred benchmark or parallelism work
definition: Empirical comparison, measurement, optimization, timing, parallelization, or incremental infrastructure work is outstanding; no correctness problem is alleged.
inclusion_criteria: 'compare the performance!'; 'very inefficient'; 'TODO: parallelize'; 'try without copying'.
exclusion_criteria: Verification by reading code; suspected correctness defects; device-capability handling; theoretical numerical precision.
boundary_examples: Measurement or concurrency only.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0086-aaicdjedb", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "FIXME: can use n_jobs here too", "interpretation": "The note proposes using n_jobs in this code path, which is a parallelization/performance improvement rather than a correctness fix. It names outstanding concurrency work with no alleged wrong result."}]

name: enhancement or example-quality desire
definition: Desirable improvement to working code, examples, or data that is not a defect: better illustrative dataset, optional multi-GPU support, example-quality suggestion.
inclusion_criteria: 'use faithful dataset'; future multi-GPU enhancement; example-quality suggestion.
exclusion_criteria: Broken behavior; absent core functionality; generic hardcoding smell.
boundary_examples: Nice-to-have, not gap or bug.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0036-aaibigjdc", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "TODO: use the faithful dataset", "interpretation": "The TODO asks to use the 'faithful' dataset in the GMM plotting example, which is an example-quality improvement to working code rather than a defect or missing capability. The example functions; the desire is a nicer illustrative dataset."}]

name: formatting, style, readability, or organizational cleanup
definition: The admitted debt is cosmetic or presentational: formatting/lint conformance, banner or grouping tidiness, or a low-confidence claim that code is hard to read, misnamed stylistically, or "could be smarter" without naming a speed, correctness or structural mechanism.
inclusion_criteria: Formatting/lint TODO; reorganize banners or grouping; "dense and confusing, clean up"; "change to functional style"; "could be smarter" with no named property or target.
exclusion_criteria: Deletion of working code with no fault (SD23); structural factoring or representation change (SD14/SD15); a named performance cost (SD17); bare marker with no object at all (SD21).
boundary_examples: If a concrete target or mechanism is named, use the specific code; this code is the residual presentational/low-confidence wish.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0010-aaaedagad", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "# TODO May want to rewrite name; index; uuid; etc.", "interpretation": "The comment suggests a potential rewrite of names, indexing, and UUID handling without naming a concrete correctness, structural, or performance mechanism. It is a low-confidence presentational or cleanup wish."}]

name: bare or underspecified deferred marker
definition: TODO has only a marker, author tag, lone noun/symbol/fragment, pronoun, truncated fragment, generic phrase, or self-doubting note with no reconstructable action or target; only debt location is inferable.
inclusion_criteria: '!TODO'; lone 'TODO'; author tag; 'market value'; 'documentation'; 'sweep'; 'debug'; 'dtype'; 'maxpool?'; 'maybe done'.
exclusion_criteria: Any interpretable defect, feature, mechanism, or direction; named verification target.
boundary_examples: Merge only when nothing concrete can be reconstructed.
representative_evidence: [{"case_id": "23shades-0002-aaehidhih", "field": "comment_text", "quote": "!TODO", "interpretation": "The artifact consists solely of a bare TODO marker with no further text, so no concrete action, target, or mechanism can be reconstructed."}]
